name: floating-viewer
title: Floating Viewer
summary: A persistent in-page media surface that can detach into a bounded, corner-snapping floating viewer without restarting its content.
useWhen: Reference media should remain visible while the user works elsewhere on the same page.
A single media instance must survive transitions between inline and floating positions.
avoidWhen: The media should continue outside the current browser tab or page, which requires the browser Picture-in-Picture API.
The interface needs multiple independently managed floating windows.
capabilities: Explicit float, move, restore, and close controls
accessibility: Every drag outcome is available through visible buttons.
The floating surface is exposed as a labeled region.
Restore brings the inline origin back into view.
Consumers retain responsibility for accessible media controls and captions.

motion.purpose: Preserve the spatial relationship between inline media and its temporary floating position.
motion.reducedMotion: Apply detach, restore, and corner changes immediately without spring movement or smooth scrolling.
